items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I played with Al Grey and I played with Vic. We played together.

ctx.x: Did you play with Watrous and Rosolino (unintelligible) this year at Dick Gibson's?
Not this year. Last year I did. Al Grey played with them this year. But last year I played with them.
Who'd you play with this year?
